"text": "Prepare a written household account map for Dana Bramblequill that distinguishes her premarital savings, individual brokerage account, rental condo cash flows, joint Teacup Comet Bank accounts, and the shared expense funding arrangement.",

},
{
"templateId": "fbbdddd5-865b-51c3-a01a-013cd6ced637",
"title": "Verify recurring payment change",
"text": "Complete these checks before confirming the recurring payment change:\n- Identify the payment being changed, including payee, funding account, frequency, and approximate amount.\n- Confirm whether the request is to add, stop, pause, resume, or modify the payment.\n- Verify client authorization using the firm's required authentication process.\n- Confirm the effective processing window and whether any payment is already pending.\n- Check for linked services, loan obligations, insurance premiums, charitable pledges, or household bills that could be affected.\n- Document the new instructions and retain confirmation from the custodian, biller, or payment platform.\n- Notify the client when the change is submitted and again when confirmation is received.\nInvestigate the duplicate townhouse mortgage contribution transfers for Dana Bramblequill at Teacup Comet Bank and resolve the recurring payment issue by the agreed date.",
"priority": "high",
"dueDate": "2026-07-16",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Dana reported that a scheduled transfer from her individual Teacup Comet Bank account and a new joint-account transfer both appear tied to the townhouse mortgage contribution, creating a risk of duplicate household funding for the same payment cycle; the agreed follow-up on the recurring mortgage contribution issue is dated 2026-07-16."
},
{
"templateId": "9170179a-0718-5240-a325-b14431a4be07",
"title": "Refresh household profile on a recurring cadence",
"text": "Every six months, review and update the household profile, including contact information, employment status, family changes, dependents, residency, trusted contacts, outside professionals, insurance coverage, education funding needs, and major upcoming cash-flow events. Document any changes that should trigger planning, beneficiary, estate document, or account maintenance follow-up.\nUpdate the household record now with Oliver Cloudpuddle's full legal name, shared residence, preferred mailing address, and contact details as provided by Dana Bramblequill, completing the update by the agreed date.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2026-07-18",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Dana provided Oliver’s full legal name, shared residence, preferred household mailing address, and contact details so the advisory household record and non‑trading contact fields can be updated separately from that authorization; the agreed update is dated 2026-07-18."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Update Dana Bramblequill beneficiary designations",
"text": "Update Dana Bramblequill's beneficiary designations on her IRA, taxable transfer‑on‑death registration (if available), Moonbadger Design Labs 401(k), and group life insurance to reflect her marriage and compare contingent beneficiary options. Complete the updates by the agreed date.",
"priority": null,

"evidence": "Dana asked for help updating beneficiary designations on her IRA, taxable transfer‑on‑death registration if available, Moonbadger Design Labs 401(k), and group life coverage to reflect her marriage and to compare contingent beneficiary options; the agreed follow‑up is dated 2026-07-25."
},
{
"templateId": "b4b28e1a-9a89-5911-87af-edffbf515fb3",
"title": "Complete policy renewal follow-up",
"text": "Use this workflow when a client receives a renewal notice or upcoming renewal reminder for an insurance, benefits, or protection policy. Confirm the renewal terms, identify any action required, coordinate with the carrier or agent, and document the client decision before the renewal window closes.\nObtain Oliver Cloudpuddle's Lavender Sprocket Insurance term life policy renewal notice and current declarations page, noting the near‑term response window, and deliver the documents by the agreed date.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2026-08-05",
"assigneeId": "6c042427-5f72-5342-b648-35e8432ac742",
"subTasks": [
{
"title": "Collect renewal notice and current policy details",
"text": "Request or locate the renewal notice, current declarations page, premium summary, coverage limits, named insured details, beneficiary or owner information if applicable, and any stated renewal action requirements. Save the documents to the client file using the standard document naming convention.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": null,
"assigneeId": "6c042427-5f72-5342-b648-35e8432ac742"
},
{
"title": "Review renewal changes and planning implications",
"text": "Compare the renewal terms with the current policy. Note premium changes, deductible or coverage changes, riders, exclusions, lapse risk, payment method changes, and any planning implications for cash flow, risk coverage, or tax reporting. Escalate material concerns to the lead advisor.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": null,
"assigneeId": "a8da8f8f-1814-56bc-93a4-f7ec3a48a450"
},
{
"title": "Contact carrier or agent for missing information",
"text": "If details are incomplete, contact [carrier or agent name] to confirm renewal status, required forms, accepted payment methods, processing timeframe, and whether any underwriting or client signature is required. Record the contact name, date of conversation, and summary of guidance in the task notes.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": null,
"assigneeId": "6c042427-5f72-5342-b648-35e8432ac742"
},
{
"title": "Confirm recommendation and client instructions",
"text": "Prepare a concise client follow-up summarizing the renewal options, advisor recommendation, required next steps, and any deadline stated in the renewal notice. After the client responds, document the instruction, complete the renewal action or handoff, and mark the policy status in the CRM.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": null,
"assigneeId": "109ee96c-98ac-5220-bb77-70a307c8c2c4"
}
],
"evidence": "Oliver said he received a Lavender Sprocket Insurance renewal notice for his term life policy, but the notice and current declarations page were not available during the meeting even though the notice references a near‑term renewal response window; the insurance renewal documentation remains needed and is dated 2026-08-05."
},

},
{

},

},
{
"title": "Confirm recommended action plan",

},

"dueDate": null,

}
],
"evidence": "Mira and Tobin noted Dana’s employer‑stock concentration in the taxable account and the additional unvested restricted stock units, and Dana wants the next vesting and trading‑window considerations reviewed before she makes any employer portal election; the agreed Moonbadder equity award review is dated 2026‑07‑29."
